shared_elements: carved stone sculpture in the round
human-like face/head with brow ridge and nose
incised cross-hatched or net-like linear patterning
justification: Both are three-dimensional stone carvings that combine a schematic face of raised lenticular eye-forms and heavy brow with shallow incised linear patterning, including hatched/net-like fields and a circular ring motif set on the body. But A is a tight close-up of a pale, crisply cut, densely cross-hatched surface, while B shows a whole dark, weathered monolith whose sparse, worn low-relief motifs are spread over a broad flat torso, so the framing, scale, material and density of ornament differ sharply.
